name: Inotribe (version B)
description: Version B of the five-page Inotribe site, built from the same requirements and copy as version A so the two can be compared. Soft black (#141414) interface with petrol teal and gold, Google Sans and Google Sans Flex, a full-width split-rail navbar (Accra clock, links in a pill track with a sliding highlight) and pill controls, drawn as a 'control room': faint column guides behind every page, bracketed section numbers, lighter and larger headings. Home has a dotted world map with animated routes out of Accra, numbered capabilities on fading pills, stat pills, a labelled data-pipeline graph for the warehouse migration, duotone case cards, a CSS tech marquee and a hairline client table. About has a staggered photo collage, mission quote over the route map, differentiators, a process timeline that fills on scroll, a JSON testimonial slider and a capabilities bento. Services has the diagonal case-study bento and capability panel. Work renders each case study from JSON as challenge, what we built and why it matters with a case index. Contact posts to Web3Forms. Navbar, numbered mobile menu, footer privacy notice, footer and a scroll-progress top button are injected from main.js.
